violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. OBSERVED COOKED CHICKEN IN WALK-IN COOLER AT 46F. CHICKEN WAS MADE AND PUT IN THE COOLER THE NIGHT PRIOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. CDI: DISPOSED OF DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED IN (1): DELI HAM AT 64F (OVERNIGHT), DELI SALAMI AT 70F (OVERNIGHT) OBSERVED IN (2): CUT TOMATO AT 45F (30MIN), COOKED CHICKEN AT 53F (30MIN), SHREDDED MOZZARELLA AT 57F (30MIN).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: TCS FOODS IN (1) WERE DISPOSED OF. TCS FOODS IN (2) WERE MOVED TO THE FREEZER.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. OBSERVED GLUE STORED WITH POP IN UNUSED COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. CDI: PIC DISPOSED OF GLUE.

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED CAN OF RAID NEAR THE BATHROOM.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. CDI: RAID DISPOSED OF DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: OBSERVED CHEMICAL SQUIRT BOTTLE WITHOUT A LABEL.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CDI: BOTTLE LABELED DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed eating, smoking, or drinking in areas where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection. Observed cigarettes being sotred on top of a food contact surfaces
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. PIC removed Cigarettes

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Ventilation System Cleaning
violations.observation: Intake and exhaust air ducts are not being cleaned at a frequency necessary to prevent contamination by dust, dirt, and other materials.
violations.corrective_action: Clean intake and exhaust air ducts at regularly intervals to prevent them from becoming sources of contamination. PIC showed EHS confirmation that they are having cleaning done tonight ( 2/9/26)

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils. Observed a pack of cigarettes and a drink container (coffee cup) being stored on the meat slicer
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. Person in charge moved employee cigarettes and coffee cup away from slicer, had slicer cleaned.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: wall mounted vegetable slicer was observed not clean to sight and touch
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. Person in charge had employee clean and sanitize the wall mounted vegetable slicer

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: flour pizza sauce, wing. Sauce, oil and various spices
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. person in charged agreed to label foods

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Insect Control Devices, Installation
violations.observation: Observed flypaper over the one compartment sink next to the walk-in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Relocate the insect control device so that it is not located over a food preparation area and dead insects are prevented from being falling on exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. personal charge took down the fly paper from the one compartment sink, proceed too wash rinse and sanitize the one compartment sink

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Window or door is kept open for ventilation and opening is not protected by a screen or other effective means. Observed the roof access hatch is being propped open for ventilation without na effective barrier preventing insects from entering the facility
violations.corrective_action: Provide screens (16 mesh to 1 inch), air curtains, or other effective means to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. EHS and person in charged agree to have the hatch cclosed

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: observed cardboard being used to line shelves above the 2 door prep top cooler and to line catch bins for dirty pizza trays
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. Person in charge removed cardboard from shelving and to stop using cardboard as a liner for a catch bins

violations.title: Equipment Clean to Sight and Touch
violations.observation: Encrusted grease deposits and/or other soil deposits were observed on the food contact surfaces of the following cooking equipment: observed deep fat fryer was not clean to sight and touch, grease and food residue deposits on fryer sides
violations.corrective_action: The food-contact surfaces of cooking equipment and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. PIC agreed to have the deep fat fryer cleaned by next inspection and to adjust cleaning schedule so it cleaned on a frequent basis PIZZA BOLI'S (Inspection Date: 09/02/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. At beginning of inspection, no CFM was present in the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PIC called CFM and CFM arrived during inspection. Have additional staff obtain CFM certification.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw shell eggs over spinach in 3 DR prep.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM moved raw shell eggs to bottom shelf of unit and/or WIC.

violations.title: Cover Foods in Storage
violations.observation: Observed opened container of cinnamon sauce underneath prep table. Observed uncovered bowl of pizza flour underneath prep table.
violations.corrective_action: Foods shall be protected from contamination by being stored in packages, covered containers or wrappings unless being cooled. EHS reviewed with CFM that all foods must be covered when not in use. CFM will have employee cover foods.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: wall-mounted vegetable chopper. Observed dried red onion pieces left on blade of wall-mounted vegetable chopper. Observed french fries and fried food debris in fry basket at left fryer.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. CFM will review with employees that equipment must be cleaned after use. CFM will have employee clean wall-mounted chopper before use. CFM will have employee clean fry basket before day’s use. CFM will review with employees that food should not be left out from previous day.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: observed 2 squirt bottles at 2 DR prep unit without labels.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM will label bottles with food name - oil, vinegar. PIZZA BOLI'S (Inspection Date: 03/10/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Outdoor Storage Surface, Nonabsorbent, Sloped
violations.observation: The waste oil container is stored on absorbent material. Observed used oil drum stored on grass area next to waste receptacle bin.
violations.corrective_action: An outdoor storage surface for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be constructed of nonabsorbent material such as concrete or asphalt and shall be smooth, durable, and sloped to drain. CFM will contact property management company and/or oil drum removal company to move drum to asphalt/concrete area.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use. Observed mop stored in soiled water in mop bucket.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. CFM will remind employees to store mops so that mop head is able to air dry in between uses.
